Hatha Yoga

Hatha yoga focuses on holding poses for several breaths to build strength, flexibility, and body awareness. Our Hatha classes are grounded in classical techniques and are ideal for beginners and those seeking a mindful, slower-paced practice. Each class emphasizes proper alignment and the connection between breath and movement.

Best for: Beginners, those seeking alignment-focused practice, building foundational strength, and mindfulness.

Vinyasa Flow

Vinyasa yoga is a dynamic, flowing practice that synchronizes breath with continuous movement. Our Vinyasa classes build cardiovascular endurance, strength, and mental focus while creating a moving meditation. We offer sessions at intermediate and advanced levels, allowing you to progress at your own pace.

Best for: Building cardiovascular fitness, creating a dynamic meditation, intermediate to advanced practitioners, and those seeking a challenge.

Yin Yoga

Yin yoga involves holding passive poses for extended periods, typically 3–5 minutes, to gently stretch deep connective tissues and joints. This meditative practice promotes relaxation, improves flexibility, and encourages introspection. Perfect for stress relief and recovery after more vigorous practices.

Best for: Stress relief, deep relaxation, improving joint mobility, recovery days, and calming the nervous system.

pages.html:

Meet Our Teachers

Our experienced and compassionate instructors are dedicated to guiding you on your yoga journey. Each brings unique expertise and a commitment to creating a welcoming space for all levels.

Priya Sharma

Hatha & Vinyasa Flow

12 years experience

Priya has been practicing yoga for over 15 years and completed her 200-hour certification in Rishikesh, India. Her warm, encouraging teaching style helps students build strength and confidence. When not on the mat, she loves hiking and practicing meditation.

Qualifications: 200-hour RYT, Advanced Pranayama Specialist

Marcus Chen

Power Yoga & Core Conditioning

8 years experience

Marcus combines his background in fitness training with yoga to create dynamic, energizing classes. He specializes in helping students build functional strength and improve athletic performance. Marcus is passionate about making yoga accessible to everyone, regardless of fitness level.

Qualifications: 200-hour RYT, Certified Personal Trainer, Yoga for Athletes

Elena Rodriguez

Restorative & Yin Yoga

10 years experience

Elena's gentle approach to yoga focuses on deep relaxation and mindfulness. Her background in physical therapy allows her to offer modifications for injuries and sensitivities. Elena believes yoga is a journey of self-discovery and creates a nurturing environment for inner peace.

Qualifications: 200-hour RYT, Yin Yoga Certified, Physical Therapy Background

James Okonkwo

Beginner Classes & Alignment

6 years experience

James is known for his patient, detail-oriented teaching and exceptional ability to explain proper alignment. Perfect for anyone new to yoga, his classes build confidence and a strong foundation. James believes every body is a yoga body and welcomes all students with open arms.

Qualifications: 200-hour RYT, Anatomy for Yoga Teachers

Sarah Wilson

Hot Yoga & Ashtanga

9 years experience

Sarah brings intensity and precision to every class. Her structured approach to Ashtanga yoga combined with invigorating heat creates transformative sessions. Sarah is committed to helping students push past their perceived limits while maintaining safety and mindfulness.

Qualifications: 500-hour RYT, Ashtanga Certified, Yoga for Athletes

Michael Torres

Meditation & Philosophy

11 years experience

Michael's classes blend physical practice with the deeper philosophical roots of yoga. His expertise in meditation and breathing techniques helps students cultivate inner stillness and spiritual growth. Michael offers an enriching experience for those seeking the complete yoga practice.

Qualifications: 200-hour RYT, Meditation Specialist, Yoga Philosophy

Why Choose Our Teachers?

Highly Qualified

All our instructors hold Yoga Alliance Registered Teacher (RYT) certifications with extensive continuing education in specialized areas.

Personalized Guidance

Our teachers provide modifications and adjustments to ensure every student, regardless of experience or ability, gets the most from their practice.

Passionate & Dedicated

Our instructors are committed to creating a supportive, judgment-free environment where you feel welcomed and encouraged to grow.

Diverse Specialties

Whether you seek calming restorative practice or dynamic flow, our varied teaching styles ensure there's a perfect class for your needs.

Add-Ons & Extras

Private Sessions

Guest Pass

Workshops & Retreats

Yoga Mala Beads

Hand-crafted mala beads for meditation practice. Members receive 10% discount on all merchandise.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I pause my membership?

Yes! If you need to take a break, you can pause your monthly unlimited membership for up to 60 days per year at no charge. Simply contact us at hello@zenithyoga.com or call (555) 123-4567.

Are class packages refundable?

Class packages are non-refundable but can be transferred to another person. If you purchase a package and cannot use it before expiration, please contact our team—we may be able to extend your access in special circumstances.

Do you offer student or senior discounts?

Yes! We offer 15% off monthly unlimited memberships for full-time students and seniors aged 65+. Please bring valid ID to your first class.

Can I use my membership for online classes?

Online class access is included with our Monthly Unlimited and Annual Unlimited memberships. Class packages and drop-in rates apply only to in-studio classes. Visit your member portal to access live and recorded sessions.

What if I want to upgrade my membership?

You can upgrade anytime! If you're on a class package, any unused classes will be credited toward your new membership. Contact our front desk for assistance with upgrading.

Do you offer corporate or group memberships?

Absolutely! We offer special rates for groups of 5 or more. Please contact us at hello@zenithyoga.com to discuss your team's needs and get a custom quote.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. Monthly memberships are billed automatically on your enrollment date.

Is there a commitment period for monthly memberships?

No! Our monthly unlimited membership has no lock-in contract. You can cancel anytime with 7 days' notice. However, annual memberships must be paid upfront.
